title: Grove: Light It Up
intro: Your first Grove build: plug a Grove LED into the Base Shield with one cable, then make it blink. No breadboard and no loose wires!

steps.title: Turn it on
steps.text:
Your Grove LED is plugged into port **D4**, so its pin is **4**. The `#define LED_PIN 4` at the top gives that number a name.

`digitalWrite(LED_PIN, HIGH)` sends power out of the pin, and the LED lights up.

**Your task:** fill in the blank so the LED turns on, then press **Run**.
hints: The blank is the word that means "on".

checks.label: I saw the Grove LED light up

steps.success: It's on! The Grove cable carried power from port D4 to the LED.

steps.title: Make it blink
steps.text:
A blink is: on, wait, off, wait, and repeat. `loop()` repeats for you.

**Your task:** add two lines so the LED turns off and the program waits half a second (500 ms).
hints: Copy the two lines above and change one word.
steps.success: Blinking! Try changing the 500s to make it faster or slower.

outro: You built your first Grove circuit and made it blink with **pinMode**, **digitalWrite** and **delay**.
stretch: Make a heartbeat: two quick blinks, then a long pause.
Plug the LED into port D7 instead. What do you need to change in the code?
Make the LED blink your initials in Morse code.
